summary: Dispatch helper that either performs a bounded copy or invokes an indirect code pointer, selected by flags in the byte at a3 and the byte at a4. Early-returns on null/empty structures at a3+4 and a3+8. When bit 8 of *a3 is set it writes a single dword from a1+24 into *v5 and fixes it up through SEHFrameOffsetCalculationHelper. When *a4 bit 1 is clear it copies via sub_58B130 (plain copy when the code pointer at a4+24 is null, otherwise validated indirect call through that pointer under an interlocked/jump-table guard). When *a4 bit 1 is set it copies via sub_58B130 and, when the copied count is 4 and *v5 is nonzero, reapplies the SEH-frame offset fixup. Invalid read/write combinations fall through to SEHGuardedFunctionPointerCall.
